invariants.description: exact first-order solution N = X + (N_init - X) exp(-t/tau), X = g_P (P_a - P_ref) + g_O2 (C_O2 - C_O2_ref) + g_CO2 (C_CO2 - C_CO2_ref)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(N - ((g_P*(P_a - P_ref) + g_O2*(C_O2 - C_O2_ref) + g_CO2*(C_CO2 - C_CO2_ref)) + (N_init - (g_P*(P_a - P_ref) + g_O2*(C_O2 - C_O2_ref) + g_CO2*(C_CO2 - C_CO2_ref)))*np.exp(-t/tau)))) <= 1e-5*max(1.0, abs(g_P*(P_a - P_ref) + g_O2*(C_O2 - C_O2_ref) + g_CO2*(C_CO2 - C_CO2_ref)))

invariants.description: f = f_0 + k_f N + f_E E
signs: pressure below P_ref with reference gases raises f

bc_sweep.rationale: MAP 40-140 mmHg; terminal O2 0.05-0.20 and CO2 0.40-0.60 mL/mL; tau 0.5-10 s.

baseline.reason: no data: a synthetic module of the known-structure test model (ICUHealthy models/simple)

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no data to calibrate against
